title: Wood floor planks
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of wood floor or deck boards with staggered joints, growth-ring grain that forms cathedral arches, knots and per-board tone. Use for floors, decks, walls and furniture panels.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python wood_planks.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: board_rows
parameters.meaning: Rows of boards across the tile height.

parameters.name: boards_per_row
parameters.meaning: Boards end to end in each row across the tile width.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.meaning: Width of the joints between boards in texture units.

parameters.name: ring_density
parameters.meaning: Growth rings per texture unit of distance from the pith.

parameters.name: knots
parameters.meaning: Chance of a knot on each board.

parameters.name: gloss
parameters.meaning: Finish from raw or weathered (0) to lacquered (1).

parameters.name: weathering
parameters.meaning: Raised grain, greying and end checks from exposure.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Oiled oak boards with fine cathedral grain.

presets.name: walnut
presets.description: Dark lacquered walnut, wide boards, subtle rings.

presets.name: knotty_pine
presets.description: Yellow pine with strong rings and frequent knots.

presets.name: weathered_grey
presets.description: Sun-bleached grey deck boards with raised grain and checks.

presets.name: white_oak_strip
presets.description: Narrow pale strips of lacquered white oak.

limits: Grain comes from a geometric ring model with noise, not from wood anatomy; there is no ray fleck, figure or end grain. Boards run along the tile width only. Knots are simple ring distortions with a dark core. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Growth rings as distance from an inclined virtual pith axis
Per-board hashing for tone, pith and incline
Staggered butt joints from a random offset per row
Fractional Brownian motion stretched along the board for pores
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
